title: Portable Conformance Kit and Clean-Room Rust Engine Port
hypothesis: Packaging Caelus's CPK1 binary packs and golden test fixtures into a standalone language-agnostic Conformance Kit enables a clean-room zero-dependency Rust engine port (caelus-rs) that achieves bit-exact CPK1 decoding and <=1e-6 parity against the Python reference with native throughput.
null_baseline: TypeScript-only golden test runner tightly coupled to Node ESM and packages/caelus/test/.
success_bar: Standalone Conformance Kit grades both TypeScript and Rust engines with 100% pass across all core ephemeris, house, aspect, event, and observe vectors; Rust CPK1 decoder produces bit-identical f64 coefficients to Python and TypeScript without runtime powf drift.
kill_criterion: Do not start Rust porting until the CPK1 binary pack format (Milestone 4) and conformance manifest schema are frozen and passing 100% on both Python and TypeScript.
dependencies: ROADMAP.md Milestone 4 CPK1 pack format frozen
